name: What is the installation process for noise reduction windows?

mainEntity.name: What is the installation process for noise reduction windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation process begins with an initial consultation and measurement of your existing window openings. Once custom windows are manufactured, our team will carefully remove your old windows, prepare the openings, and then precisely install the new noise reduction units. This includes proper sealing and insulation to maximize soundproofing and energy efficiency. The final step involves finishing touches to ensure a seamless integration with your home's aesthetics. The duration depends on the number and type of windows being replaced.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, measurement, removal of old windows, installation of new units with proper sealing, and finishing touches. Duration varies by project size.
